what: iOS 27 Liquid Glass merge geometry (UIGlassContainerEffect / SwiftUI GlassEffectContainer), measured on device
probe: tool/ios_reference (Sources/Merge.swift scenes merge / mergeDyn / mergeID; UITests testMerge / testMergeDyn; device.sh PROBE_PLAN=merge|mergedyn)
scene: pairs of glass shapes, one container per pair, magenta-tinted .regular glass over flat 50% grey; capsules 60x44 centred x=110, circles 44x44 centred x=300, rows y=150+80i for gaps [40,30,20,15,10,6,3,0,-5] pt; pages spacing 0,10,20,40,80

files.profiles-uikit.json: per spacing page and pair: silhouette height H(x) in pt sampled every 1/3 pt between the two shape centres (UIKit UIVisualEffectView + UIGlassEffect in UIGlassContainerEffect)
files.profiles-swiftui.json: same for SwiftUI GlassEffectContainer(spacing:){HStack(spacing: gap){.glassEffect(.regular.tint, in: Capsule()) x2}}
files.necks.json: midline neck heights per api/spacing/kind/gap with the derived modulation m = 4(a - 0.40)/spacing and sin(theta/2); m == sin^2(theta/2) within 1 percent
files.sdf-layers.json: CASDFLayer / CASDFElementLayer properties per page (smoothness == spacing)
files.dynamic.json: drag/animate necks vs the static law, smoothness over time, glassEffectID per-frame element rects, glassEffectUnion note
files.fit-per-pair.json: rms/max error of the sin^2 law (k = spacing) and of the renderer's sin law per pair
files.merge-params.json: the fitted law, rejected variants, SDF parameters, defaults, recommendation
